title: Saturday Morning
description: Tom Service chats to composer Caroline Shaw about her extraordinary creative world. Also, Tom talks to Errollyn Wallen about her latest opera, A Christmas Miracle.

title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
description: Jools is joined by the writer Robin Llewellyn to discuss Portmeirion and its musical connections.

title: Key Changes: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
description: 1897, Vienna. Beneath Vienna's cultural brilliance, anxiety about the future is beginning to influence a new generation of composers.

title: Record Review
description: Andrew McGregor with the best new classical releases.

title: Sound of Cinema
description: The stories behind the movies, told through music, with Edith Bowman- featuring interviews with Behemoth! director Tony Gilroy and star Pedro Pascal alongside composer Emily Bear.

title: This Classical Life
description: Jess Gillam swaps musical choices with the violinist and presenter of Radio 4's Add to Playlist, Anna Phoebe.

title: Opera on 3
description: Ginger Costa-Jackson sings Carmen at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden, with Russell Thomas as her obsessed Don José and Sesto Quatrini conducting.

title: Music Planet
description: Lopa Kothari presents the best in folk and roots-based music from around the world, including a live session from Ghanaian kologo player King Ayisoba.

title: New Music Show
description: Highlights from the opening weekend of this year's Huddersfield Contemporary Music Festival, including the UK premiere of James Dillon's Lamentations :.

title: Through the Night
description: Jakub Hrusa conducts the Zurich Tonhalle Orchestra in Suk's Symphony No 2 in C minor 'Asrael'. Organist Christian Schmitt joins them for Hosokawa's Embrace - Light and Shadow.

title: Breakfast
description: Radio 3's breakfast show, waking the UK up with the finest classical music.

title: Sunday Morning
description: Join Sarah Walker for the perfect Sunday playlist with music for advent and concertos by Ethel Smyth and Joseph Haydn.

title: Private Passions
description: Michael Berkeley's guest is the actor and star of Bridgerton, Luke Thompson.

title: Music Map
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch roams the musical landscape around JS Bach's Advent cantata 'Wachet Auf!', with Handel's Fireworks, Wagner's night watch and The Everly Brothers' wake up call.

title: A Service for Advent with Carols
description: A Service for Advent with Carols, live from the Chapel of St John's College, Cambridge, with music by Lucy Walker, Gibbons, Laura Sheils, Wayne Marshall and Bach.

title: Jazz Record Requests
description: Alyn Shipton has the pick of your requests featuring a galaxy of jazz stars, including Dizzy Gillespie, Billie Holiday and Miles Davis.

title: The Early Music Show
description: Hannah French talks to Robert Hollingworth, founder of the solo vocal ensemble I Fagiolini, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year.

title: Classical Mixtape
description: Take time out with a 30-minute soundscape of classical music, including a motet by Bruckner and Venus from Holst's The Planets.

title: Sunday Feature: Berkeley's Britten
description: For the first time, Michael Berkeley tells the story of the relationship between his godfather, Benjamin Britten, and his father, the composer Lennox Berkeley.

title: Words and Music
description: Impressions of impressionism with readings from Monet's letters and poems about water lilies and hay fields alongside music by Debussy, Cécile Chaminade, Erik Satie and Ravel.

title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
description: Hannah is joined by members of Easington Colliery Band, who accompanied Sam Fender on his Mercury Prize-winning album.

title: Compline
description: A reflective service of night prayer from the Chapel of Lambeth Palace, London, led by the Archbishop of Canterbury and sung by St Martin's Voices.

title: Night Tracks
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

title: Unclassified
description: Elizabeth Alker with a late-night journey through new music from today's most exciting genre-defying artists.

title: Through the Night
description: Pianist Vadym Kholodenko joins the Norwegian Radio Orchestra and conductor Leslie Suganandarajah in Brahms's Second Piano Concerto, and the orchestra plays Schubert's 4th Symphony.
